problem: The derivative description is broken: it reads 'The derivative is −1 for x0', so the two cases of the derivative of |x| are lost and the sentence makes no sense to a student.
fix: The derivative is −1 for x<0 and +1 for x>0, so no c has f′(c)=0.

problem: 'Otherwise one extreme value occurs inside (a,b)' is ambiguous: in the non-constant case it is not a particular chosen extreme that lies inside, but at least one of the two extremes must.
fix: If f is constant, every c works. Otherwise, since f(a)=f(b), at least one of the highest and lowest values is attained at an interior point c of (a,b).
